name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.0.7: stop showing Weimis aisle flags on kiosk-owned machines. Weimis isEnable and isBroken govern nothing on a machine running our kiosk, and neither we nor the machine can write them, so bays that sell perfectly were being labelled faulty or closed. The layout endpoint now returns stockSource, and both the restock rows and the bay grid suppress Weimi-derived fault/closed badges, tints, tooltips and the clear-fault action when stockSource is kiosk. The kiosk-local off badge and the stop-selling / enable-for-sale toggle remain, since those reflect the flag the operator actually controls. Weimi-owned machines are unchanged. Cumulative over v6.0.6.
